ios.desc:
Your daily AI news briefing, without an endless feed.

Prism turns each day's AI news into one short brief: model releases, LLM research, new tools and startup funding. Swipe through concise stories summarized by AI, see why each one matters, and open the original source whenever you want more detail.

YOUR DAILY AI BRIEF
• Seven stories in a compact daily digest.
• Clear summaries, context, and practical takeaways.
• Source links so you can explore the reporting behind each story.

FOLLOW WHAT INTERESTS YOU
Choose topics such as AI models, agents, tools, research, startups, funding, business, and policy. Explore recent stories and put your interests first.

START FREE
Read the first three stories in each daily brief with the free version.

MORE WITH PRISM PREMIUM
• Read the complete daily brief.
• Listen to your digest read aloud while you commute, walk, or make coffee.
• Save useful stories and organize your library.
• Search and revisit a 30-day archive.

BUILT FOR CURIOUS PEOPLE
Whether you build with AI, follow the market, or want to understand new research, Prism helps you make keeping up part of your day. A guided setup helps you choose your interests, goals, and preferred format, with a clear reading experience in light and dark.

Prism uses AI to summarize reporting from linked sources. Every story includes a link to its original source.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Prism Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription. Available plans, prices, billing periods, and any eligible free trial are shown before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or after any applicable free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.prismai.news/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.prismai.news/tos

show_hn.title: Show HN: Prism, a trusted AI news digest for iOS

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I built Prism, a production ready iOS app for a daily AI digest.

What’s different vs typical AI news feeds:
 • Evidence badges per story so you can judge source quality fast (Official, Reputable, Paper, Community)
 • Try This prompts per story so you can immediately test ideas, tools, or workflows
 • Save and tag items (Read later, Build, Research) plus Explore search for past digests
 • Smart notifications for the daily drop

It’s freemium: free gets a few items, Pro unlocks all daily items plus full archive and notifications.

App link: https://apps.apple.com/en/app/prism-trusted-ai-digest/id6757409783?ref=hackernews

Feedback I’d love:
 • Which evidence levels feel most useful
 • Ideal daily volume (7 vs 10)
 • Any missing sources you wish every AI digest covered
